claims.label: Company overview
claims.value: Power cable solutions: high-, medium- and low-voltage cables, cable accessories and cable services.

claims.label: HV cable production & offshore cable-laying
claims.value: High-voltage cable production and offshore cable-laying capabilities (following the acquisition of ABB HV Cables in Sweden).
claims.excerpt: With the acquisition of ABB HV Cables in Sweden, NKT increased capacity of HV cable production and offshore cable-laying capabilities

claims.label: 525 kV DC cable system
claims.value: 525 kV cable system described as a key element in developing a DC grid that uses renewable energy generation more efficiently.
claims.excerpt: The 525 kV cable system is a key element in developing a DC grid that can use renewable energy generation more efficiently.

claims.label: First HVDC MI submarine cable
claims.value: Historical milestone: the first HVDC MI submarine cable, connecting Gotland with the Swedish mainland.
claims.excerpt: NKT launches the first HVDC MI submarine cable.
